page.layout: One page of running text, one column. Printed running head with page number at top: "CAP. II: 4." at left, "ILLUSTRATUS" in the centre, "369" at right. No margin notes. Text runs down the page; a Hebrew-letter paragraph opener at the foot of the text. Catchword "ab" at the right below the last line. Gathering signature "Aaa." at the left foot.

main_text.p: manu hostium, & protectionem ab irâ Dei, ubi tam male missum à Deo prophetam exceperant. Tunc enim experti sunt, ut hac sua subductione Deum in Christo deserendo semet non solum offenderint gratiâ Dei indi-gnos, sed etiam se subtraxerint alis defensionis divinæ, quoniam viderunt se à Deo traditos in potestatem hostium. Saltem ipse Titus Vespasianus observavit Dei manum; adversus ipsos belligerantem, eosdemque eousque tan-quam profugos, suisque desertores, & hostes ejus factos insequentem, ut ad amicos suos se convertens dixerit, Σὺν θεῷ ἐμαχησάμεθα, ὦ ἀνδρες! cum Deo expugnavimus, ô viri! Imo Suidas auctor est eundem Ægyptiis coronas triumphales victori offerentibus dixisse: non ego hoc feci; sed Deo irato, populum suum ob peccata ca-stigare volenti, manus meas accommodavi. Jure merito voce ecce jubemur oculos dirigere in subducentes, præ amore sacrorum abrogandorum à Christo sese aver-tentes, eaque armis defendere molientes: qui non per-pendebant, quod in festo pentecostes eorum Sacerdotes, templum interius ingressi, post auditum strepitum & sonitum etiam vocem claram & distinctam audiverant, monentem μεταβαίνωμεν ἐντεῦθεν, migremus hinc: vocem inquam, numinis secessum una cum loci profanatione, cultus istius abrogatione, nec non defensionis divinæ ablatione indicantem. Hæc attendenti etiam porro, videre daretur quemcunque eorum tristi fato (hunc fame, alium peste, tertium gladio) occumbentem; paucosque evadentes tanquam bruta animalia ad miserrimam [?]servitutem damnatos, distractosque; imo videre daretur illud ipsum confugium subversum, profanatum & conculcatum in secula: ut usque in diem hodiernum experiantur Deum subductionis istius strenuum vindicem.
ב. Contra vero Christiani, in testimonium caussæ,

page.notes: The running head "CAP. II: 4." at the top left is a section marker, not part of the running title, so it is left out of running_head. The Hebrew letter ב opening the last paragraph is transcribed as printed. Doubtful readings: "servitutem" (the word is partly smudged) and "suisque" (the q is unclear). Dropped "s" long s was read as "i" in "istius". The line "ab" is treated as the catchword. No printing errors were left unmarked.
